description:
Export private retained incident evidence for a UTC Unix-second window within 30 days.
    Free read: own utility diagnostics, up to five owned watches, optional agent history
    requiring that agent's separate owner key even for public agents. Returns a versioned
    JSON timeline, coverage/truncation notes, checksum and original signed tokens where
    retained. sign=true authenticates the complete historical artifact with Ed25519; it does not
    renew tokens, prove complete retention or certify reliability. sign=false requests the legacy checksum-only export.
    Save the JSON privately. No public sharing, new checks, registration or credit spend.
name: export_incident_evidence
